test: none: a regression between SolidCraft 0.30.1 (truck) and 0.40.0-rc.3 (solidcore); the report's script
summary: SolidCraft 0.40 refuses a small round on the outer rim arc of a partial revolve that turns about 280 to 320 degrees with 'not supported yet: the fillet is larger than the faces beside its edges allow', while a larger radius on the same edge builds; 0.30.1 builds them all (#14416). The report's script: the rectangle [2, 10] x [0, 8] on XY revolved about the y axis, and a round or chamfer on the outer top arc (radius 10, y = 8). Here the profile is revolved with the runner's revolve step about the y axis through the origin, and the edge is picked at (-10, 8, 0), 180 degrees round the axis, which lies on the arc whichever way the revolve turns and is no vertex; the inner arc's control at (-2, 8, 0). Replayed with solidcraft-cli built on GitHub's runners (fork SychPL/solidcraft branch fork-ci-14416, run 42978928893): main 27de5ba0 and v0.40.0-rc.3 refuse the 0.4 round at 280, 300 and 320 degrees, the 1 mm round and the 0.4 chamfer at 300, and build the 0.4 round at 270 and 330, the 2 mm round at 300 and the inner arc's 0.4 round at 300, each within 7e-8 of the expected volume; v0.30.1 builds all nine. On solidcore every refused case is an ERROR, 'blend::fillet_executive::session::finish: upstream status 1001: refused; the largest size that builds is 0', with no fixes and with all of SolidCraft's (kernel_cases/fixes.json, a fork probe gives the same verdicts), so the cases carry no fixes; the others pass within 8e-8. Expected volumes are closed form, by Pappus: the rectangle (area 64, centroid 6 from the axis) gives 64 * 6 * t; a round of radius r takes the spandrel (1 - pi/4) r^2, whose centroid lies c r = (10 - 3 pi)/(12 - 3 pi) r in from the edge on both legs, at R - c r from the axis on the outer arc (R = 10, the material inside it) and R + c r on the inner one (R = 2); a chamfer of legs d takes d^2/2 with its centroid d/3 in. The report's own figures agree: 2008.84 at 300 degrees, 1807.95 at 270 and 1967.68 for the 2 mm round. Tolerance per case: 1e-8 of the volume (the integrator's accuracy) plus 1e-5 times the round's or chamfer's area (a face anywhere within the body's 1e-5 tolerance of exact), rounded up: 0.0001 to 0.002 mm^3; below what a radius 0.1% off changes (0.0036 mm^3 for the 0.4 round at 300 degrees, 0.086 for the 2 mm one).

cases.name: round_0_4_at_300_degrees
cases.note: The report's case: a 0.4 round on the outer top arc of a 300 degree revolve. solidcraft-cli on GitHub's runners (fork run 42978928893): main 27de5ba0 and v0.40.0-rc.3 refuse it ('not supported yet: the fillet is larger than the faces beside its edges allow'); v0.30.1 builds it.

volume.formula: 64*6*rad(300) - rad(300)*(1 - pi/4)*0.4^2*(R - c*r), R = 10, c = (10 - 3*pi)/(12 - 3*pi) (Pappus: the rectangle less the round's spandrel); tol 0.0004 mm^3
